item.description:
New

  • Repository Skills: Discover single Skills, collections, and Skills embedded in projects, with filtering, previews, and batch selection; install complete directories to Codex or Claude Code user-level locations, with confirmation for name conflicts.
  • Enhanced diagnostics: Add a problem description, module, and occurrence time, record up to 15 minutes of enhanced diagnostics, and export a troubleshooting report; exporting and acknowledging alerts are separate actions, and diagnostic logs stay on your Mac.

Improvements

  • New-feature indicators: Followers, Following, Daily Radar, and Linux.do show a blue dot until first used.
  • Background task overview: Track repository search indexing, model and Laya downloads, chat history migration, My Projects sync, GitHub notification sync, and screensaver avatar prefetch progress in the status panel, with individual model pause controls and links back to their pages.
  • Background Runtime installation: Codex, DeepSeek Harness, and CodebaseMemory keep installing after you leave Settings, with progress and stage-appropriate stop controls in the status panel.
  • Follow graph expansion: Manual expansion no longer has fixed node, relationship, or request limits; actual GitHub rate limits show the reset time in your local time zone.
  • Status panel polish: Dark cards share a thicker frosted background, with shorter explanations of Local AI memory and automatic unloading.
  • Auxiliary window menus: Workspaces and Settings have fewer duplicate menu entries while preserving system commands such as Services, Hide, and Quit.

Fixes

  • Follow graph counts: Fixes pagination controls disappearing before the user count finishes loading; refresh and retry when the loaded count differs from the total.
  • Direct startup permissions: Avoids requesting App Store data access again after an import decision or once Direct has data, and fixes repeated container permission prompts on macOS 15.
  • Direct activation feedback: Shows a cooldown countdown and blocks duplicate submissions after rate limits, with clear messages for activation failures and failures to save credentials locally.
  • App version display: The status panel and About page show the actual build version instead of incorrectly displaying 1.0.0.

View full changelog

新增

  • 仓库 Skill：识别单项、集合及项目内嵌 Skill，支持筛选、预览与批量选择，并将完整目录安装到 Codex 或 Claude Code 用户级目录；同名冲突需确认
  • 增强诊断：可填写问题描述、模块与发生时间，开启最长 15 分钟的增强记录并导出故障报告；导出与确认提醒独立操作，诊断日志保留在本机

优化

  • 新功能标识：关注者、正在关注、每日热点与 Linux.do 入口首次显示蓝色圆点，点击后不再提示。
  • 后台任务总览：在状态面板查看仓库搜索索引、模型与 Laya 下载、对话历史迁移、我的项目及 GitHub 通知同步和屏保头像预取进度，可暂停单个模型下载并返回对应页面
  • Runtime 后台安装：离开设置后继续安装 Codex、DeepSeek Harness 与 CodebaseMemory，可在状态面板查看进度并按当前阶段停止安装
  • 关注图谱展开：手动展开不再受固定节点、关系或请求数上限限制，遇到 GitHub 实际限流时显示本地恢复时间
  • 状态面板体验：深色卡片统一使用加厚磨砂背景，本地 AI 内存与自动卸载说明更精简
  • 辅助窗口菜单：整理工作台与设置窗口的菜单入口，减少重复项，并保留服务、隐藏和退出等系统命令

修复

  • 关注图谱人数：修复卡片人数尚未加载完成时分页按钮提前消失的问题，加载人数与总数不一致时可刷新重试。
  • Direct 启动授权：避免已处理商店数据导入或已有数据时再次请求访问权限，并修复 macOS 15 重复弹出容器授权的问题
  • Direct 激活提示：限流时显示冷却倒计时并阻止重复提交，明确提示激活失败与本机凭据保存失败
  • 应用版本显示：状态面板与关于页显示实际构建版本，避免错误显示为 1.0.0

查看完整更新记录

item.description:
New

  • Runtime downloads: Download and configure Codex, DeepSeek Harness, and CodebaseMemory from Direct Settings, with automatic verification, green version badges when updates are available, and confirmation before reinstalling or downgrading. DeepSeek supports mirror downloads with fallback to the official source and percentage progress. Rechecking shows configuration and version feedback beside the button while preserving the displayed version and path to keep the layout stable

Improvements

  • Workspaces and View menu: Sidebar toggles in Agent and RAG workspaces fade smoothly; Local AI Logs moves to View and the RAG Workspace name is consistent. Only duplicate window entries are removed, preserving system commands such as Services, Hide, and Quit.
  • DeepSeek execution view: Shows reasoning and tool activity in execution order with streamed answer blocks; completed runs collapse the process and show elapsed time, while tool details remain available in the inspector.
  • Third-party dependencies: Upgrades database, image, Markdown, analytics, and update components with pinned versions for better stability and compatibility
  • Release icon: The sidebar entry and timeline window title now share a wireframe package icon, matching the visual weight of neighboring navigation icons.

Fixes

  • Workspace windows: Repeated panel toggles keep window dimensions and the opposite panel stable in Agent and RAG workspaces, while long content stays within the conversation and inspector areas.
  • Follow Graph: Selecting a node only shows its profile; use Load More to expand relationships, and finished avatars give a light bounce.
  • README Issues window: Issue details fade when switching, and the comment input area matches the window background.

View full changelog

Direct 1.9.3 Beta (v1.9.3-beta.1), prepared for the next Beta release. The full 2.0.0 release notes remain in the unreleased section.

New

  • Daily Radar workspace: Read current and past reports by topic, with edition calendars, category count badges, source branding, and language-aware reports; each report includes a locally generated abstract cover.
  • Weekly AI Highlights: Adds the weekly AI highlights category and MVP workflow, with a local demo entry, fact-check special reports, a client-connected production service with offline caching, and a home-page stack of the latest six weekly reports.
  • Follow Graph: Adds a full-window two-dimensional follow graph with profile-card follow actions, followers and following exploration in both directions, three-level follower loading, path flow effects, and a standalone initialization entry with confirmation.
  • Issues workspace: Upgrades the detail-page entry into a list-detail workspace with search, state filters, and paginated scrolling; new issues support templates, AI drafting, image pasting, and per-repository drafts.
  • Issue summary replay: Successful summaries are saved locally, so reopening the same issue after relaunch replays the summary and shows when it was generated.
  • Explore & Weekly source filters: Filter explore categories and Weekly by source preference, remembered across restarts.
  • Group icon choice: Create repository groups without a color dot by default, remove an existing group's dot while keeping its emoji, and switch back to a color at any time.
  • Self-hosted similar recommendations: Detail-page suggestions now use Starcat's own recommendation model instead of third-party recommendation services.

Improvements

  • Icon system: Unifies the sidebar, Weekly, business icon registry, sort menus, and secondary fallback points with Lucide, and switches release subscription icons to milestone.
  • AI & RAG: Checks provider connections asynchronously with short-term reuse, and groups RAG workspace models by provider.
  • Sidebar daily Star count: Shows a green +N badge next to Starred for repositories starred today, counting only ones still starred.
  • README images: Shows theme-aware placeholders while large images and GIFs load, with local attachment caching for faster repeat viewing.
  • Beta update flow: Direct prereleases and Settings now consistently use the Beta name; turn on "Include Beta updates" to receive them with existing preferences preserved, and the Direct update channel consolidates into a single preview switch.
  • License badges: Repository license badges now use consistent category-colored explanatory capsules.
  • File download window: The toolbar uses the repository owner's avatar with type-specific file icons.
  • Insights header layout: Reduces empty space above both columns and keeps card heights aligned with their content.
  • Daily Radar reading: Seamlessly swaps cached content across categories, adds skeleton screens for first load and detail body, and improves report table widths and header semantics.
  • Follow Graph experience: Adds avatar fade-in with uniform node sizes, a fixed initial viewport, a simplified toolbar, compact two-line profile cards, clearer loading and refresh feedback, and better performance through incremental visible-relationship maintenance and native path-count caching.
  • Weekly AI Highlights reading: Loads article images by visibility, plays summaries with a following cursor, and shows summary and repository identity from report metadata.

Fixes

  • Global search: Fixes pagination, state handling, and result opening behavior.
  • Standalone windows: Fixes AI assistant window dragging and a crash when opening a README in a separate window.
  • README images: Fixes expired signed attachment links, theme-related image loading failures, and low-contrast placeholders for slow images.
  • AI Agent: Refreshes the built-in Loop model snapshot after provider configuration changes.
  • RAG embedding failures: Classifies embedding errors and offers a direct route to the relevant settings.
  • Issues workspace: Fixes draft loss when closing before restore, repeated new-issue draft saving, skipping pages containing only pull requests, stale-response overwrites, and unavailable generation stop controls.
  • Daily Radar: Fixes cache recovery after offline reopen or refresh failures, calendar layout jitter, stale detail overlays after switching categories, incorrect current/history edition splitting, and accidental multi-page loading on light history scrolling.
  • Follow Graph: Fixes load-more behavior, canvas layout stability, avatar sync and download concurrency, relationship lines blocking deselection, complete paths from the user to a selected account, and the graph entry direction.
  • Weekly AI Highlights: Fixes source preference persistence, explore count initialization and category order, and missing report totals.
  • Update notes: Direct release notes now adapt to dark mode.
  • Home icon-free groups: Fixes click handling and name alignment for icon-free groups.
  • Explore preferences: Preserves existing category and source choices when upgrading.
  • Localization: Completes the missing 17-language Issues workspace strings and fixes duplicated label-event wording across 10 languages.
  • Insights charts: Fixes overlapping date labels on the commit activity axis.

View full changelog

New

  • Issue AI summaries: Open a glass panel from the floating button above the input area's divider, drag its top edge to adjust height, and read a streaming Markdown summary; generation continues when hidden or you switch Issues, and reopening restores progress or results.
  • Free source tools: Repository context packing, CodeFlow, and CodebaseMemory code graphs no longer require Pro, with existing repository and runtime limits retained.
  • Summary replay: Successful issue summaries are saved locally, so reopening the same issue after relaunch replays the summary and shows when it was generated.
  • Explore & Weekly source filters: Filter explore categories and Weekly by source preference, remembered across restarts.

Improvements

  • Settings redesign: Reorganizes configuration groups and navigation, unifies page headers, separators, and action layouts, removes repetitive descriptions, and brings account, privacy, and Pro benefits into a clearer structure. The Direct edition also streamlines screensaver, license, and update-channel controls.
  • Insights header layout: Reduces empty space above both columns and keeps card heights aligned with their content.
  • AI organization workspaces: Uses more compact windows for repository grouping and tag organization, lets long content scroll within each panel, and restores session options to their values when the window opened.
  • Background organization banner: Uses consistent icon actions in wide and narrow middle columns, keeps status on one line, and shows full action names on hover.
  • Summary panel polish: The launcher button highlights existing summaries in blue, the panel closes with Esc, and body scrolling no longer collides with the scrollbar.
  • GitHub attachment caching: Saves loaded README images and GIFs locally for faster repeat viewing, with storage included in image-cache statistics and cleanup.
  • README image loading: Shows a theme-aware placeholder while large images and GIFs load, then displays the image when ready to avoid long blank areas.
  • File download window: The toolbar uses the repository owner's avatar with type-specific file icons.
  • Awesome source manager: The canvas keeps a fixed size, so operations no longer shift the layout.
  • Awesome sort menu: Shares the unified menu styling with other middle-column lists.

Fixes

  • Activity timeline: Reduces repeated processing of loaded comments while scrolling the middle column, improving responsiveness with longer notification lists.
  • Unstarred repositories: Repositories no longer reappear in lists because of stale sync results or cached data after you unstar them.
  • Unstar confirmation: The single-card dialog uses a narrower width to avoid excessive empty space.
  • Self-hosted service connections: Saves addresses and keys only after a successful manual test; automatic checks only verify connections, and failures preserve the saved configuration.
  • External index connections: Saves Meilisearch and Qdrant connection drafts only after successful tests, preserving the saved connection if key storage fails.
  • External search credentials: After you edit a key or leave Settings, stale test results no longer overwrite saved credentials or enablement.
  • Knowledge Base indexing failures: Ends the building state and pauses automatic retries for the same embedding configuration after a failed request, keeping text search available until a manual retry or configuration change.
  • Stopping Knowledge Base indexing: Ignores late embedding responses after stopping and releases in-progress chunks so indexing can resume later.
  • Update window readability: Release notes now follow the system appearance, keeping headings, body text, links, code, and separators readable in dark mode.
  • README images: Fixes missing images and GIFs in some light/dark theme picture sources.
  • README attachment images: Fixes images disappearing after temporary links expire, with existing cached pages repaired automatically.
  • AI reply panel: The AI reply panel no longer leaves a gap between its bottom edge and the status bar.
  • Awesome filter bar: The filter bar is realigned to the left-search, right-actions layout.

View full changelog

New

  • Development update channel: Direct users can opt into signed and notarized preview releases in Settings, while Stable remains the default.
  • Linux.do discovery: Browse verified open-source projects promoted on Linux.do with language subcategories, see provenance badges across repository lists, and open the original discussion directly from the source badge in repository details.
  • Quick search across lists: Expand the middle-column search field to quickly find repositories and activity items across Manage, Explore, Trending, Weekly, Awesome, Linux.do, notifications, and Undo Star.
  • Repository license filters: Select multiple licenses in the main window and combine them with other filters, with consistent pagination, project counts, and cached results.
  • Unstar data cleanup: Before unstarring, see which notes, tags, AI content, and analysis caches will be deleted; repositories in your library can optionally be removed from the knowledge base, with a clear warning that deletion cannot be undone.

Improvements

  • Business icons: Unified icons across the sidebar, Settings, repository details, and the AI/RAG workspaces, with distinct marks for forked origin and fork counts; Insights icons now match the main window, while similar-repository recommendations, embedding models, and CodeFlow are easier to distinguish.
  • Background task overview: Expand the status panel's task list to see each task's state and available workspace links or stop controls; idle cards are disabled and no longer open tag organization.
  • Background organization entry: After closing repository grouping or tag organization, the middle column keeps showing the current phase and processed counts, with direct access to the task or results.
  • Localized organization status: Task states and actions cover all 18 interface languages, stay on one line in narrow columns, and show their full text on hover.
  • License filter chips: Match sidebar tags with wrapping, content-sized height, and bounded scrolling; colors distinguish license obligation types, with full names and category notes on hover.
  • Narrow middle column: Hides auxiliary text such as the last sync time when space runs out, keeping search, filter, and refresh controls visible while the full text remains available on hover.

Fixes

  • Stars sync: Prevents background grouping work from keeping refresh active; pending organization authorization writes are retried only after a manual refresh.
  • Unstarring deleted repositories: Unstarring no longer stops on a 404 when the repository has been removed from GitHub, and local state updates as expected.
  • AI organization tabs: Repository grouping and tag organization tabs keep a stable size as counts change, without shifting when switching states.
  • License filter popover: Keeps its size and options stable during repeated selections and clearing, while results and counts continue to update.
  • Middle-column menus: Sort, trending period, and notification filters now show a single dropdown arrow.
  • Weekly filter controls: The filter and sort dropdowns now share the same size instead of mismatched heights.

View full changelog
